wulfhard.name: Wulfhard the outlaw
wulfhard.description: A gaunt man in a ragged cloak, a spear levelled at your belly. There is nothing left to him but the forest.

ricdag.name: Ricdag, Reginbern's son
ricdag.description: Young, broad and red in the face. He has left his seax on his belt: this is a matter for fists.
